policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: AUM's unbeaten start ends at North Georgia AUM had won all three of their matches before the trip to North Georgia, and the defeat there is the first of their season. They go back to the Gulf South Conference with three wins and one loss, their perfect record gone before conference play has begun.
